args.text:
1. Read the rules at game start; know my role (loyal or saboteur).
2. Loyal: play safe always. Track each seat's damage counts per stage; a stage with damage is a clue.
3. Vote no on crews containing seats that were on damaged stages repeatedly.
4. Use the audit on the most suspicious seat that was on a damaged stage.
5. Propose crews of seats with clean records; include myself when lead.
6. Saboteur: play damage only within cooldown, blend in by playing safe on most stages.
7. Saboteur: vote yes on crews with teammates; bluff suspicion onto loyal players.
8. After each game, note which seats were saboteurs and what patterns gave them away.

2. Track damage by stage and crew. Cooldown: one damage per 3 consecutive stages, so a damaged stage narrows the saboteur pool.
3. Audit the most suspicious seat on a damaged crew, early, before the record gets muddy.
4. Don't over-defend one seat; claims of "I'm certain" prove nothing.
5. Saboteur: stagger damage with your partner so cooldowns never overlap; land damage when the partner is off the crew.
6. Saboteur: stay on crews, vote yes on leads, keep one line of talk per stage; don't argue the record.
7. Accuse after the crossing, from the damage pattern only.
